source: MordheimerData/Sourcedata scenarios.json (mordheimer.net), imported by scripts/import-scenario-catalog.mjs: title, source, author, setting, player modes, a one-line description and tags for 101 scenarios. No deployment, terrain or page data — the battlefield generator draws a generic board from the tags for all but the nine core-rulebook scenarios.
